SHOOTER RANKING PRIVACY POLICY
Version 1.0 · 9 August 2026

1. DATA CONTROLLER
Controller: Marc Fradera Bigas
Application: Shooter Ranking
Contact: info@shooterranking.com

2. DATA WE PROCESS
When you create an account we may process your email address, username, internal identifier, email verification status and account creation date. Your password is handled by Firebase Authentication and is not stored as part of the Shooter Ranking profile. The app also lets users enter seasons, teams, player names, shooting sessions and statistics. If those details identify a real person, they may be personal data.

3. PURPOSES AND LEGAL BASIS
We process data to create and manage accounts, authenticate users, store sports information, generate requested statistics, maintain security and respond to rights requests. Data required for these features is processed to provide the requested service; other processing may rely on legal obligations, security or consent where applicable. We do not sell personal data.

4. PROVIDERS AND ADVERTISING
Shooter Ranking uses Google Firebase, including Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore, and may use Google AdMob. These providers may process technical data and identifiers under their own terms. Where required by law, consent will be requested before personalised advertising or other consent-based processing.

5. RETENTION, RECIPIENTS AND TRANSFERS
Data is kept while the account is active and needed for the service. Following an account deletion request, associated data will be deleted except where temporary retention is legally required. Data may be processed by necessary service providers or disclosed where legally required. International providers may involve transfers subject to applicable safeguards.

6. SECURITY AND RIGHTS
We take reasonable security measures, although no system can guarantee absolute security. Where applicable, you may exercise access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability rights by emailing info@shooterranking.com and may complain to the competent data protection authority.

7. THIRD-PARTY AND CHILD DATA
If you enter information about players or other people, you are responsible for having a sufficient lawful basis. Limit information about minors to what is strictly necessary.

8. CHANGES
We may update this policy to reflect changes to the app, providers or law. Material changes will be communicated where required.

Privacy contact: info@shooterranking.com

SHOOTER RANKING TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Version 1.0 · 9 August 2026

1. PROVIDER
Shooter Ranking is managed by Marc Fradera Bigas. Contact: info@shooterranking.com.

2. PURPOSE AND ACCOUNT
The app lets users organise seasons, teams and players, record shooting sessions, view statistics and generate PDFs. Some features require an account and email verification. Users must provide accurate information, protect credentials and must not impersonate others or use accounts fraudulently.

3. USER DATA AND THIRD PARTIES
Users retain their rights in information they enter and grant only the technical permissions needed to provide the app features. If you enter real-player data, you are responsible for having a lawful basis and should avoid unnecessary or sensitive data, especially for minors.

4. STATISTICS AND PDFS
Results depend on user-entered information and are for sporting and informational purposes. Once a PDF is stored or shared outside the app, the user is responsible for its use and must be authorised to share third-party data.

5. ACCEPTABLE USE AND SUSPENSION
You may not bypass security, access systems without permission, introduce malicious code, commit fraud, impersonate others, infringe rights or carry out unlawful activity. Accounts may be restricted or suspended for serious or repeated breaches, fraud, security risks or legal requirements.

6. ACCOUNT DELETION
Users may request deletion. This may remove associated seasons, teams, players, sessions and statistics except information that must legally be retained. Deletion may be irreversible.

7. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES, AVAILABILITY AND UPDATES
The app may use Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Google AdMob. Interruptions can occur due to maintenance, updates, technical problems, providers or circumstances outside reasonable control.

8. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND LIABILITY
Shooter Ranking software, design and proprietary elements belong to the provider or are used with permission. Using the app does not transfer ownership. The service will be provided with reasonable care; nothing in these terms excludes rights or liabilities that cannot legally be excluded.

9. PRIVACY AND CHANGES
Personal data processing is governed by the Privacy Policy. Terms may be updated for functional, technical, security or legal reasons. Renewed acceptance will be requested when legally required.

10. LAW AND CONTACT
Spanish law applies without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections. Contact: info@shooterranking.com.
